subject: Banking
title: The Bank of Banks
description: One-minute skill: The Bank of Banks.

hook.text: Central banks don't serve ordinary people. They serve banks. The Federal Reserve is JPMorgan's bank.

buildup.text: Commercial banks hold reserve accounts at the central bank, just like you hold an account at a commercial bank.

discovery.text: Central banks clear interbank payments, set reserve requirements, and provide emergency loans.

twist.text: Before central banks, banking panics happened regularly.

climax.text: Central banks exist because banking systems need a backstop. Someone has to be the bank that never runs out of money.

punchline.text: The bank's bank. Central banks backstop the entire financial system.

quiz.question: Who are central banks' primary customers?
